text:
Mike: quick coordination thread for this week's sprint wave — want to lock owners/times for each rollout lane and smoke owners. can we call slots now?

Laura: I can take Wave A (model-serving changes). aiming for 09:30-09:50 PT wed. will run smoke at +10m after deploy.

Sanjay: I can pair with Laura for the canary. taking 09:50-10:10 PT canary window. i'll be on pager.

Ana: I'll own smoke checks for both Wave A + B. prefer smoke window 10:00-10:20 PT. badge me 10m before.

Kevin: i'll be backup rollback owner for any of the waves. noted on 30-min standby after each canary.

Mike: thanks. @deploy-bot can you reserve the slots and post the runbook link?

deploy-bot: Slot reserved: Wave A 09:30-09:50 PT (owner: Laura), Canary 09:50-10:10 PT (owner: Sanjay), Smoke owner: Ana. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/wave-runbook-2026 :white_check_mark:

Laura: QA smoke checklist (short):
- health endpoints OK
- end-to-end inference on sample prompt
- no error spike in logs (>1/min)

Sanjay: quick smoke script i'll run locally:```bash
# run after canary stable
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/svc/infer -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' | jq '.status'
```

Ana: for metrics watchlist: CPU/GPU util, 99th latency, error rate, kv-cache hit ratio. set alert if 99th > 500ms or errors > 0.5%

Kevin: rollback plan: if canary fails, revert to image tag `release-2026-07-14-a`. rollback command: `./tools/rollback.sh --tag release-2026-07-14-a --force`

Mike: perfect. small ask — please drop a short note in this thread when your slot is started/finished so we have a timestamped audit.

Laura: will do. starting checklist preflight at 09:15 PT wed. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: i'll post canary start + end. prepting metrics dashboards now.

Ana: i'll be on the channel for smoke and will post results (pass/fail).

Kevin: standby set. ping me immediately if rollback is needed.

Mike: thanks all. moving this to the deploy calendar. see you wed morning.

Laura: :rocket:
